name: Microsoft Semantic Kernel
description: Microsoft's enterprise SDK for LLM orchestration, now in maintenance mode.
descriptionZh: 微软的企业级 LLM 编排 SDK，现已进入维护模式。
keyFact: Semantic Kernel, first released on 17 March 2023 and used inside Microsoft 365 Copilot, has been merged with AutoGen into Microsoft Agent Framework; Microsoft committed to at least one year of critical fixes on Semantic Kernel v1.x after MAF's 1.0 GA, with all new features going to MAF.
keyFactZh: Semantic Kernel 于 2023 年 3 月 17 日首发，并在 Microsoft 365 Copilot 内部使用，现与 AutoGen 合并为 Microsoft Agent Framework；微软承诺在 MAF 1.0 GA 后至少一年内继续为 Semantic Kernel v1.x 提供关键修复，所有新功能均进入 MAF。
caveat: In maintenance mode following the merge into Microsoft Agent Framework; only critical fixes are expected.
caveatZh: 在并入 Microsoft Agent Framework 后处于维护模式，预计仅提供关键修复。
